description: Linux kernel GPIO driver for NCT5104D Super-I/O chip, including register access functions, GPIO bank management, device probing, and initialization.

methods.name: superio_inb
methods.description: Reads a byte from the Super-I/O register.

methods.name: superio_inw
methods.description: Reads a word (2 bytes) from the Super-I/O register.

methods.name: superio_outb
methods.description: Writes a byte to the Super-I/O register.

methods.name: superio_select
methods.description: Selects a logical device in Super-I/O.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_direction_in
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin as input.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_get
methods.description: Reads the value of a GPIO pin.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_direction_out
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin as output.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_set
methods.description: Sets the value of a GPIO pin.

methods.name: nct5104d_find
methods.description: Detects the Super-I/O chip at a given address.

methods.name: nct5104d_gpio_exit
methods.description: Cleans up the GPIO driver module.
